briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Google Gemini 3 race ahead as US tightens export controls on advanced chips

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race has intensified with multiple frontier labs releasing upgraded models this quarter. Compute shortages and regulatory pressures are reshaping alliances across the US, EU, and Asia.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deployed o4 with 4.2T parameters while Anthropic released Claude 4 Opus. Meta open-sourced Llama 4 and DeepSeek V4 matched Western performance at lower cost.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. NIST released new red-teaming guidelines for multi-agent systems.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC began shipping 1.4nm process nodes dedicated to AI accelerators. Microsoft and xAI announced joint 200k H100 cluster in Texas while Saudi Arabia broke ground on a 500MW AI data center.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first ASI-level system emerge from a US lab or a China-backed consortium by 2028?
